maul: next:
  1. Install the App on acme (choose the organization, not your own account):
     https://github.com/apps/maul-acme/installations/new
     Select the repositories maul works on.
  2. kubectl create -f '/tmp/my dir/s.yaml' && rm '/tmp/my dir/s.yaml' && kubectl apply -f '/tmp/my dir/f.yaml'
     Run it once maul is installed: it needs namespace maul-system and maul's CRDs.
